We are aligned with the vision of having the happiest clients and the happiest mystery shoppers—we don’t want to be the biggest, we want to be the best. We are looking for highly motivated, detail-oriented individuals to join our team as Professional Mystery Shoppers.

This is a flexible and critical role where you provide essential, objective feedback that helps our clients achieve excellence. Our shoppers come from all walks of life, to better represent the customer base of our clients in a variety of businesses like shops, cafes, fast food restaurants, beauty clinics, pharmacies and even vets. 


Why Become a Mystery Shopper?

Mystery Shopping is an excellent way to boost your income. It’s incredibly flexible and perfect for fitting in around your other commitments. You don’t need prior experience, provided you have the skills and tech listed below. We include detailed instructions for every project, to make sure you know what to expect. 

The ideal candidate will possess:
* Exceptional Attention to Detail: The ability to observe, recall, and accurately report on specific service and environment criteria. We deal only in facts, so accuracy is paramount.
* Strong Communication Skills: Excellent written communication skills to accurately and professionally document experiences and articulate feedback. Verbal communication is essential for in-person visits or phone call surveys, so you must be easily understood.
* Technologically Confident: Comfortable using technology, including a reliable mobile phone and computer (or laptop/tablet) with stable internet and email access for receiving assignments and submitting reports.

How much will you get paid?

We pay our Mystery Shoppers for every completed assignment—we don’t ask them to work for freebies or to consider a free meal as their payment.

Reimbursements: Meals and purchases are in addition to the payment. If a purchase is required, Mystery Shoppers use their own money, then are paid back with their survey payment. All information provided before you accept an assignment.

Fast Payments: At Above Benchmark, we are incredibly proud to have the fastest Mystery Shopper payments in the country. Payments are processed weekly into the nominated bank account. We do not pay in vouchers, freebies, or PayPal.

Above Benchmark is one of Australia’s leading Mystery Shopping Providers. Due to recent growth and new client partners, we are now recruiting Mystery Shoppers in numerous cities and regional towns across Australia.  
   

CURRENT OPENING:  

We are looking for a Mystery Shopper who owns a dog or cat and can take their pet to a vet for a consultation. Payment for this survey is $30, PLUS you will be reimbursed for the consult fee up to $130. These are great surveys for pet owners and are especially suitable for annual vaccinations or a general health check-up.  

You will be provided instructions and a survey form for each job, then simply visit the target client and act just like a regular customer, while observing everything. Upon completion, you log into our Mystery Shopping software and enter the results including any required photos and receipts.   
  

TO JOIN OUR TEAM YOU WILL NEED;  

  • regular and reliable access to the internet, email and a ideally a printer  

  • an excellent memory and report writing skills  

  • confidence to role-play and improvise  

  • fantastic communication skills; verbal and written  

  • confidence in computers/smartphones, etc.  
  

Mystery Shopping is an excellent way to boost your income. It’s incredibly flexible and perfect for fitting in around your other commitments. It’s very casual and you apply for the mystery shops that you're interested in doing. Full instructions are provided along with any specific requirements, deadlines and full details if you need to purchase something.    
   

PAY STRUCTURE:  

Mystery Shop payments are different for each job and are based on the time needed to perform the Mystery Shop. Mystery Shop payments range from $15 - $30 for phone calls and $20 -$50 for onsite visits. Meals and purchases are in addition to the mystery shop payment. If a purchase is required, Mystery Shoppers are paid back with their survey payment.   

At Above Benchmark we are incredibly proud to say we have the fastest Mystery Shopper payments in the country with pays being processed weekly.  


PAYMENT REQUIREMENTS:  

Mystery Shoppers are typically independent contractors, not employees. They can invoice us with an ABN or they can choose to complete a simple form from the ATO stating they are undertaking Mystery Shopping as a Hobby. Mystery Shoppers are not required to supply a TFN and are responsible for their own superannuation, tax and insurance.  

  
ABOUT US:  

Above Benchmark is a member of the Mystery Shopper Professional Association in the Asia-Pacific region ensuring we adhere to a strict code of conduct policy. We have over 2 decades of experience, happy clients in almost every industry and thousands of professional mystery shoppers on our team. We help small businesses grow, help big businesses remain industry leaders and provide casual and flexible work opportunities to those looking to boost their income.  

   
HOW TO APPLY:  

If you meet the above criteria and would like to apply to join our team, please visit our website for more details, informative blogs and Mystery Shopper testimonials. Our confidential application form can be found here:   http://www.abovebenchmark.com.au/become-a-shopper/   

Thank you for considering our Mystery Shopping position. We look forward to your application!

We are looking for a skilled and detail-oriented ICT Support and Test Engineer to join our team and play a key role in maintaining the integrity, performance, and quality of our systems and infrastructure. This role combines technical support, quality assurance, and systems testing to ensure seamless operations and adherence to established standards. The ideal candidate brings a methodical approach to problem-solving, strong communication skills, and a solid foundation in ICT systems and environments. This position suits an experienced professional who thrives in a collaborative setting and is committed to delivering high-quality technical outcomes.
## Key Responsibilities
- Schedule and conduct quality audit inspections across systems, data, and documentation, identifying variations and potential high-risk areas to ensure continued adherence to established standards and procedures.
- Investigate, diagnose, and resolve system problems and performance issues, providing hands-on troubleshooting support for desktops, hardware, software, printers, databases, operating systems, email platforms, and network connectivity.
- Test the functionality, behaviour, and integrity of systems and application code within defined testing protocols and quality frameworks, identifying and documenting errors, faults, and deviations from specification.
- Develop, implement, and maintain quality assurance processes, guidelines, and strategies to support system reliability, security, and performance across the organisation.
- Recommend and facilitate corrective action plans to address non-compliance issues identified through ongoing monitoring, auditing, and review of operational processes and procedures.
- Perform organisational systems architecture reviews and assessments, providing well-informed recommendations on current and future hardware and software strategies aligned with business needs.
- Develop and deliver technical guidance, training, and support to end users and stakeholders on application software, operational procedures, and best practice usage.
- Communicate and liaise effectively with users and management to promote awareness of quality control standards, data integrity requirements, and ICT compliance obligations.
- Create, review, and maintain comprehensive technical documentation including procedural guides, operational manuals, technical specifications, testing reports, and maintenance inventory records.
- Assist in the planning and execution of system upgrades, installations, configurations, and patch management activities to minimise disruption and maintain system availability.
- Monitor and evaluate system infrastructure to proactively identify risks and opportunities for improvement, contributing to the ongoing optimisation of ICT environments.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams and project stakeholders to support the delivery of ICT initiatives and ensure quality outcomes are achieved throughout the project lifecycle.
## Required Qualifications & Skills
- A bachelor's degree or diploma in Information Technology, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related discipline; or equivalent demonstrated experience in a similar ICT role.
- Proven experience in ICT technical support, systems testing, or quality assurance within a professional environment.
- Strong understanding of testing methodologies, quality assurance frameworks, and audit processes across systems and software.
- Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues across a broad range of ICT systems, including hardware, software, operating systems, and network components.
- Experience developing and maintaining technical documentation such as test plans, procedural guides, specifications, and operational manuals.
- Solid knowledge of database management, system security, backup procedures, and infrastructure performance monitoring.
- Proficiency in diagnosing software and hardware faults and delivering appropriate solutions within agreed timeframes and service levels.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a structured, methodical approach to quality assurance and issue resolution.
- Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to convey technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
- Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a team, managing competing priorities and deadlines effectively.
## Preferred Qualifications
- Relevant industry certifications such as ITIL Foundation, CompTIA A+, CompTIA Network+, ISTQB (Software Testing), or Microsoft Certified qualifications.
- Experience with enterprise-level systems, cloud platforms, or virtualisation technologies such as AWS, Azure, or VMware.
- Familiarity with IT service management (ITSM) tools such as ServiceNow, Jira, or Zendesk.
- Exposure to Agile or DevOps delivery environments and associated testing practices such as continuous integration and automated testing.
- Previous experience conducting formal ICT audits, architecture reviews, or compliance assessments.
- Knowledge of relevant Australian and international ICT standards and frameworks, including ISO/IEC 27001 or COBIT.

- Be part of a collaborative, forward-thinking team that values innovation, continuous improvement, and professional growth.

- Competitive salary package with opportunities for career progression within a growing and dynamic technology function.

## Position Overview
We are looking for a skilled and detail-oriented Telecommunications Technical Officer or Technologist to join our team and contribute to the delivery of reliable, high-performance telecommunications infrastructure. This role is responsible for the design, installation, maintenance, and optimisation of complex communication networks and systems across a range of technologies. The ideal candidate brings solid hands-on technical experience, strong analytical capability, and the ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment. This position suits a proactive professional who is committed to maintaining the highest standards of network performance and service delivery.
## Key Responsibilities
- Install, configure, and maintain microwave, satellite, telemetry, and other radio and electromagnetic communication systems, ensuring all equipment operates to specification and within regulatory requirements.
- Diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve network faults, performance issues, and equipment malfunctions in a timely and effective manner, minimising disruption to services.
- Integrate telecommunications networks with computer hardware, software platforms, operating systems, databases, and peripheral devices to ensure seamless end-to-end functionality.
- Monitor the ongoing performance of complex networks and communication systems, identifying trends, anomalies, and areas for optimisation before they impact service quality.
- Plan and support the development of customer access network infrastructure, contributing to capacity planning, design reviews, and upgrade programmes.
- Maintain accurate and up-to-date documentation including inventory logs, equipment records, asset statuses, and communication policies, procedures, and quality standards in accordance with organisational and regulatory guidelines.
- Provide clear technical advice and support to internal stakeholders, project teams, and end users on telecommunications systems, configurations, and best practices.
- Liaise with vendors, suppliers, and external service providers to coordinate procurement, installation activities, and ongoing service delivery, whilst monitoring contractual performance and obligations.
- Support the design and optimisation of network architecture, contributing technical input to projects aimed at improving reliability, scalability, and performance.
- Conduct routine inspections, preventive maintenance, and equipment testing to ensure network integrity and compliance with applicable standards.
- Assist in the development and review of technical documentation, including network diagrams, standard operating procedures, and incident reports.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams on telecommunications projects, providing technical expertise throughout the project lifecycle from scoping through to commissioning and handover.
## Required Qualifications & Skills
- A diploma, advanced diploma, or bachelor's degree in Telecommunications Engineering, Electronics, Information Technology, or a related field; or equivalent industry experience in lieu of formal qualifications.
- Demonstrated experience in a telecommunications technical role, with hands-on exposure to radio frequency (RF), microwave, satellite, or fixed-line communication systems.
- Solid understanding of network protocols, telecommunications standards, and systems integration principles.
- Proficiency in configuring and troubleshooting network hardware, software, and associated technologies including switches, routers, and transmission equipment.
- Experience with network monitoring tools and fault management systems, with the ability to interpret performance data and take corrective action.
- Strong documentation skills with the ability to maintain accurate records, produce technical reports, and adhere to quality and compliance standards.
- Effective communication skills, with the ability to convey technical information clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
- Ability to manage competing priorities, work methodically under pressure, and deliver outcomes within agreed timeframes.
- A valid Australian driver's licence, as field-based work and site visits may be required.
- Willingness to participate in an on-call roster or undertake out-of-hours work when operational requirements demand.
## Preferred Qualifications
- Relevant industry certifications such as Cisco CCNA/CCNP, CompTIA Network+, or equivalent telecommunications qualifications.
- Experience working with microwave backhaul systems, fibre optic networks, or mobile network infrastructure (2G/3G/4G/5G).
- Familiarity with Australian telecommunications regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements, including those governed by the ACMA.
- Exposure to project management methodologies and experience contributing to telecommunications infrastructure projects.
- Knowledge of ITIL frameworks or experience working within a managed services or enterprise network environment.
